dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the visible posterior portion of the trunk.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical outward protrusion on the left lateral margin relative to the right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a subtle cool-toned grey cast across the entire dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low; negligible mottling, limited to a faint darker vertical streak along the spinal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; low-contrast gradient between the slightly darker dorsal midline and lighter lateral flanks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single linear, dark-pigmented vertical mark is visible along the mid-dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Presence of a shallow longitudinal crease or fold along the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent longitudinal linear mark or marking is visible along the center of the back.
